name: pr-ui-compare
description: Create synchronized Before and After UI comparisons for pull requests with Playwright.
author: Anas Bouzid

untrustedWorkspaces.description: PR UI Compare runs project install and development server commands.

languageModelTools.name: pr-ui-compare_createComparison
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a labeled Before and After GIF without creating or modifying files in the user's repository. It resolves a baseline Git ref into a detached worktree, starts the baseline and current workspace applications sequentially, replays the exact same declarative Playwright actions against both, stores artifacts outside the repository, and opens a preview. Always use this tool directly for PR UI comparisons; never write a JavaScript, TypeScript, Playwright, or shell helper script. It supports smooth, persistent camera zoom toward a target element so viewers can orient before detailed interactions, followed by an eased return to the full frame. It can also animate viewport resizing from the left, right, or both edges for centered page placement. Border color and each pane's label corner are configurable. Zoom and resize are optional and should only be used when relevant to the change. It normally uses side-by-side layout and automatically stacks extremely wide focused elements vertically. Use after a UI fix or feature is implemented and before creating or updating a pull request. The start and optional install commands execute project code and require user confirmation.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Record the same UI scenario before and after the current changes without modifying repository files.

baseRef.description: Git branch, tag, or commit for the Before application, normally upstream/main or the PR target branch.

startCommand.description: Shell command that starts either application. Use {port} where a dynamically allocated port should be inserted.

readyUrl.description: HTTP URL polled until the application is ready. Use {port} for the allocated port.

installCommand.description: Optional dependency installation command run only in the temporary Before worktree.

route.description: Route opened before replay, such as /settings.

beforeLabel.description: Optional short label shown over the Before recording.

afterLabel.description: Optional short label shown over the After recording.

beforeLabelAlignment.description: Corner for the Before label. Defaults to top-left.

afterLabelAlignment.description: Corner for the After label. Defaults to top-right.

borderColor.description: Six-digit hex color for pane frames, the divider, and unused resize canvas. Defaults to GitHub dark border #30363d.

focusLocator.description: Optional Playwright locator for the UI region to crop around throughout the recording, such as a menu bar or panel.

focusPadding.description: Padding in pixels around the focused UI region. Defaults to 16.

layout.description: Comparison arrangement. Auto keeps side-by-side unless a focused region is at least three times wider than tall.

name.description: Short description of the behavior being demonstrated.

locator.description: Playwright locator string, preferably role=, text=, label=, or data-testid=.

width.description: Target viewport width for a resize action.

height.description: Target viewport height for a resize action.

anchor.description: Edge or edges that move during resize. right keeps the left edge fixed, left keeps the right edge fixed, and both moves both edges equally so the page remains centered. Defaults to right.

scale.description: Camera magnification for a zoom action. Defaults to 1.8 when a locator is provided. Use 1 without a locator to zoom back out.

prUiCompare.retentionDays.description: Number of days to keep temporary recordings and comparison sessions outside the repository.

prUiCompare.allowSystemBrowser.description: Allow fallback to installed Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge when managed Chromium is unavailable. Keep disabled on macOS to avoid launching applications from the system Applications folder.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
